exactPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Three original transparent 2D hand-painted game sprite frames of the SAME Daoist Child (道童) walking east, second half of his step cycle. 
Reference roles: image 1 is the exact original character identity and exact nose-right camera. Image 2 is legacy motion reference only: use ONLY its BOTTOM row f3, f4, f5 poses. Image 3 is the leg-placement close-up from the legacy sequence: use ONLY its BOTTOM row f4, f5 to see which shoe is raised. Images 4 and 5 are the established hand-painted Daoist Q style only. Do not draw UI or copy the legacy boy's red hair, sportswear or black shoes.
Generate ONE wide sheet with exactly THREE equally sized invisible cells in a single horizontal row. True transparent background and transparent vertical gutters. Each cell contains one whole centered character, hair through shoe soles, no clipping. All three faces have the same strict nose-right profile as image 1, with one visible ear and eye. Identical camera, head scale, hips position, head height, ground line. Large brown short spiky head, gold headband, warm amber eye, deep jade split vest with fine gold cloud embroidery, white loose sleeves and puffy trousers, rounded jade/gold ivory-toe boots. Exactly ONE gold gourd held at chest by the far left hand. The near right hand stays empty, and its visible sleeve/arm swings forwards. Make the short legs readable below split vest. Far limbs remain slightly darker and visually behind the visible near limbs, with identical outfit and boot design. No letters, pose labels, extra marks, floor, ground shadows, glow, haze, scenery or other objects.
LEFT: f3 neutral passing pose with both shoes close and both soles near the common baseline, far boot a little behind near boot. The visible eye is half-closed, a short blink. Near arm relaxed vertical.
MIDDLE: f4 the NEAR RIGHT leg goes diagonally BACK and ends at a CLEAR foreground screen-LEFT boot planted on the common baseline. The FAR LEFT knee is bent forward and its smaller boot rises screen-RIGHT of hips, much higher than foreground boot. The near arm swings forward; show the empty near right fist clearly in front of the near sleeve near belly. Open eye. The screen-right shoe is explicitly the FAR foot, so show the body-to-knee connection leading to the bright foreground shoe on SCREEN LEFT.
RIGHT: f5 retain the same near-right-screen-left trailing boot, but it has just lifted its heel off the ground, toe dips. The far-left-screen-right boot now lands below its prior raised position. The visible empty near right hand is still forward. Open eye. Preserve the near and far anatomical ownership, and distinct contact poses.
Use clean controlled painting, warm gold highlights, readable silhouette at 90px. Keep 12 percent clear air in each cell to enable safe extraction. Make the whole image truly RGBA transparent.
